name: Robin's Fair Prices
summary: Farm buildings from the carpenter get cheaper and go up faster, and you choose how big the discount is in the config.
logoPrompt: A small red wooden barn with a white trimmed door, a carpenter's hammer and a short stack of planks leaning against it, one gold coin in front
description: **Robin's Fair Prices lowers the gold, materials and construction days of the farm buildings at the carpenter's shop.**
- Covers coops, barns and sheds with all their upgrades, plus fish pond, mill, silo, slime hutch, stable, well, shipping bin and pet bowl.
- Three levels in the config: 75 %, 50 % (default) and 25 % of the normal cost. At 50 %, a barn costs 3,000g, 175 wood and 75 stone.
- Faster building: most projects are done the next day at 50 % or less, never in under one day.
- Gold and materials are rounded up, so every building still needs a little of each material.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Change the level in the generated `config.json` or in Generic Mod Config Menu.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher.
- Magical buildings, cabins and house upgrades keep their normal prices.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
